summary: Phase 0-D research design COMPLETE. Method draft, novelty matrix, experiment matrix, engineering spec, and design decision produced. CONDITIONAL GO for controlled simulator-based strategy transfer research. Zero implementation, zero API cost, zero training.

design_gates_detail.DESIGN-01: Three mechanisms genuinely different (statistical testing, optimization, spatial interpolation). Anti-toy controls specified.
design_gates_detail.DESIGN-02: Neutral evaluator in separate process. No reward branching on strategy ID.
design_gates_detail.DESIGN-03: Source-only extraction interface specified. Strategy schema typed. No target gold access.
design_gates_detail.DESIGN-04: Independent prereg commit, paired budgets, floor checks, uncertainty plan specified.
design_gates_detail.DESIGN-05: Direct collisions documented. Narrow contribution claims C1/C2/C3. Unverified works flagged.
design_gates_detail.DESIGN-06: ~2000 LOC, 2-3 days, $0 CPU. Process isolation and RNG plan defined.

decision_rationale: Design is technically sound with genuine mechanism diversity. Novelty contribution is narrow but defensible. CONDITIONAL on full related work audit and independent DGP review before implementation.

tests.note: Design round only. No code implementation or testing.

limitations: Robin, AI Scientist, PrimeScientist etc. not fully audited
